verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a durable-execution architecture in which interrupted runs resume from their last checkpoint instead of starting over. That covers surviving worker or platform restarts without losing state. Nothing in the pack shows long waits (delay or wait-for-days steps), and the restart guarantee rests on a single first-party line. Missing for 10: documented multi-day wait/delay/pause steps, details of how checkpointed state is persisted across restarts, independent or hands-on corroboration of resume-after-restart behavior.
